constraints: Reference enums/catalogues prove an exposed name or contract, not a working source/encoder/plugin backend
Reference Rust crates are a domain/API study and explicitly declare unavailable vendor backends; they are not a proven broadcast engine
A green functional CI run does not make all reference features present or qualify performance
No proprietary assets, extracted binary code or unapproved runtime dependency is imported
Latest trace-log corrections override earlier reference summaries; shortcut names, accepted HTTP functions and state models are distinct evidence sets

ui_workflows.name: Basic / Advanced presentation
ui_workflows.scope: Independent persisted UI mode; Basic retains both monitors, Quick Play, input selection/cut/overlays 1-4, Add Input, audio mixer and lock. Does not change Program or multiview choice.
ui_workflows.gap: Hosted widget/native Basic correction passed; overlays/audio/inputs retain the general prototype limitations. Global-mode restore has source coverage only; native save/reopen verifies project configuration. The existing lock suppresses production keys; a complete pointer/layout lock contract is unverified.

ui_workflows.name: Named input playlist
ui_workflows.scope: 1-16 saved lists, at most 128 items, independent effects/hold times, reorder, loop/manual/selected start/clear-on-start, start/stop/next/previous and offline alarms.
ui_workflows.gap: Explicit synthetic/PNG holds only; no file-duration inference, video end events, pause/seek or media playback engine.

ui_workflows.name: Keyboard bindings / palette
ui_workflows.scope: Validated persisted logical key/modifier/action mappings, focus/repeat guards and quick action palette.
ui_workflows.gap: At most 64 bindings and the implemented engine action subset; no 777-function dispatcher, MIDI or control surfaces.

ui_workflows.name: Four transition slots
ui_workflows.scope: Each saved slot has a real CPU effect and duration; in-flight transition pins its configuration.
ui_workflows.gap: 12 of 20 observed effects; no stingers/GPU equivalence or vendor-pixel parity.

ui_workflows.name: Manual T-bar
ui_workflows.scope: First slot selects manual effect/duration; gesture pins effect/duration/start, reverses and commits endpoint once.
ui_workflows.gap: UI-013 regression pending; CPU raster only, no hardware controller qualification.

ui_workflows.name: Input Settings transactions
ui_workflows.scope: Staged persisted PNG/generator effects, Cancel discard, bounded loading/relink, duplicate and source lifecycle.
ui_workflows.gap: No ten-layer transform/crop/rotation animation graph, full color tools or real video/device properties.

ui_workflows.name: Input category filter
ui_workflows.scope: Schema4 stable per-input category assignment, six standard plus sixteen editable custom definitions, context-menu assignment and real category filters.
ui_workflows.gap: UI-013 hosted acceptance pending; no vendor pixel/protocol parity claim.

ui_workflows.name: Input search
ui_workflows.scope: Staged Input Search dialog with OK/Cancel, case-insensitive title/type/number filtering and no implicit switching.
ui_workflows.gap: UI-013 hosted acceptance pending; at most48 query characters, no remote search protocol.

ui_workflows.name: Theme and Preview/Program colors
ui_workflows.scope: Original persisted Dark/Light appearance and RGB Preview/Program roles; colors reach monitor headers and source selection.
ui_workflows.gap: UI-013 hosted acceptance pending; operator/media cards retain dark surfaces, vendor theme list/pixel parity and physical DPI are unqualified.

ui_workflows.name: Fullscreen Program outputs
ui_workflows.scope: Fullscreen expands the application window; routed-output menu explicitly says unavailable.
ui_workflows.gap: No independent Program-only monitor window, two routed fullscreen outputs, display selection or hotplug handling.

ui_workflows.name: Audio Mixer pane toggle
ui_workflows.scope: Actual Audio Mixer hide/show with complete previous dock restoration; saves retain the complete layout.
ui_workflows.gap: UI-013 hosted acceptance pending; changes to the temporary hidden layout are not persisted; no physical monitoring/audio backend.

ui_workflows.name: Settings categories and fields
ui_workflows.scope: Atomic name/preferences apply, staged categories/theme/keys, explicit read-only unavailable display/output scaffolds.
ui_workflows.gap: UI-013 hosted acceptance pending. Most of256 declared reference properties have no backend and cannot be configured.
